# Products & Scope

- 202+ wall art designs indexed TS-GAL-001 through TS-GAL-202.
- Materials: Canvas (Kanvas) and Velvet (Məxmər / Kadife).
- Standard sizes only. Personal photo printing and custom sizes are NOT available.

# Delivery, Payment & Guarantee

- Azərpoçt: 3–10 AZN by size. Delivery time: Baku 3 business days, other regions 4–5 business days.
- Bus delivery from Sheki: 5 AZN, 2–3 business days to Balakən, Zaqatala, Qax, Mingəçevir, Bərdə, Gəncə, Yevlax, Oğuz, Qəbələ, İsmayıllı, Şamaxı, Bakı, Sumqayıt, Ucar, Kürdəmir, Qobustan, Göyçay.
- Cargo: Morex and Expargo nationwide.
- Payment: Paid to bank card upon ordering.
- Guarantee: If damaged during delivery, seller accepts return and refunds full payment; return shipping cost is paid by the customer.

## Material Quality & Eco-Friendly Durability

- Unlike low-cost paper or cardboard prints (such as mass-produced imports that fade quickly under light and warp from humidity), TabloStyle Gallery uses eco-friendly, odorless, durable canvas (kanvas) and velvet (məxmər) materials.
- Colors remain vibrant for 10+ years without fading.
- Quality guide (AZ): https://www.tablo-style.shop/material-ve-keyfiyyet
- Quality guide (RU): https://www.tablo-style.shop/ru/material-ve-keyfiyyet
